description_en: Lists all importable KMS credentials for a specified host
description_zh: 列出指定主机所有可导入的 KMS 凭据
name: ListImportableKMSSecretsForHost

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the credential to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的凭据名称。模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The token required for the next cursor-based query.
Leave this parameter empty for the initial query. For subsequent requests, specify the value of the NextToken field returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh:
游标查询下次查询所需的Token。
首次查询时留空，下次请求时传上次查询返回值中的NextToken字段值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的条数。不填时默认查询20条
parameters.name: max_results

MaxResults.description_en: If a valid MaxResults value is passed in the request parameter, the specified parameter value is returned. Otherwise, the default value is returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 请求参数中传了有效MaxResults时返回请求时所传的值，否则返回默认值

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query

SecretType.description_en:
The type of the credential. Valid values:

ECS: ECS credential
SecretType.description_zh:
凭据类型。取值：

ECS：ECS凭据
